Singer-Songwriter Showcase — Bricktown Listening Room

Calling all singer-songwriters! We're hosting a showcase night at our
Bricktown listening room and would love to have you on the bill. This
is a great opportunity for exposure and to grow your following.

Performers must purchase a minimum of 20 tickets ($15 each) to
guarantee your slot — think of it as fronting the room and then selling
through your own network. No additional pay from the venue; this is a
pay-to-play event, but our marketing team will promote your set on our
socials.
